title: Modernising the correction of errors
text:
This measure introduces new requirements to correct inaccuracies in returns and documents provided to HMRC. It consists of an obligation on taxpayers to correct identified errors and gives HMRC a new power to issue a customer correction notice. 

 Responses to technical consultation are due by 7 September 2026. Send responses to  tarcompliance@hmrc.gov.uk .
changeNote: This legislation becomes operative on 1 April 2028. The section ‘policy objective’ has been updated to confirm we will use assessment and penalty provisions in an aim to improve compliance. The ‘current law’ section has been updated with more information. ‘Proposed revisions’ has been updated with more detail about the legislation. The update in section ‘Impact on individuals, households and families’ and in section ‘Administrative impact on business including civil society organisations’ confirms there is an explicit obligation on taxpayers to correct errors once they are identified.
